meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会添加一个只读的网页仪表盘，自动从命令行工具（如 ncl、docker）读取资源列表，生成标签页和表格，并显示代理状态、消息活动、日志和文件查看器。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 添加一个基于 CLI 的只读仪表盘，或需要监控 NanoClaw 代理组、会话、消息活动时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 clidash 仪表盘。
say.note: Claude 会复制工具文件并创建配置。

say.text: 启动 clidash 并查看代理状态。
say.note: Claude 会运行服务器并打开仪表盘。

say.text: 配置 clidash 显示 Docker 资源。
say.note: Claude 会修改配置文件添加 Docker CLI。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds a read-only web dashboard that automatically reads resource lists from CLI tools (e.g., ncl, docker), generates tabs and tables, and displays agent status, message activity, logs, and a file viewer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add a CLI-derived read-only dashboard, or when you need to monitor NanoClaw agent groups, sessions, or message activity.

say_en.text: Add the clidash dashboard for me.
say_en.note: Claude copies tool files and creates config.

say_en.text: Start clidash and show agent status.
say_en.note: Claude runs the server and opens the dashboard.

say_en.text: Configure clidash to show Docker resources.
say_en.note: Claude edits config to add Docker CLI.
